kangaroo-island-49.name: Waterfall Creek Hike
kangaroo-island-49.bio: A trail from the Western River car park down to a creek, stepping stones and a lookout over a seasonal waterfall.
kangaroo-island-49.ticket_note: Walk is in Western River Wilderness Protection Area, which has no NPWS park page (parks.sa.gov.au slug 404s); the tourism listing points to the Flinders Chase page, which does not cover this area. Left out.
kangaroo-island-49.coordinates_source: Midpoint by length of the Walking SA GPX track for Waterfall Creek Hike (6.3 km, walkingsa.org.au/walk/find-a-place-to-walk/waterfall-creek-hike/); OSM has no route for it
notes: Name drops the draft's '(Flinders Chase)': the walk is in Western River WPA, off Colmans Road, not in the national park. Pin is the midpoint of an out-and-back GPX, so it sits near the lookout end.
No entry fee found for Western River WPA; treated as free.

kangaroo-island-50.name: Return Road Hike
kangaroo-island-50.bio: The lightkeepers' old cart track from Harveys Return to Cape Borda, through sugar gum woodland past their cemetery.
kangaroo-island-50.coordinates_source: resolve-pin MEDIUM: midpoint of OSM way 'Return Road Hike' (2.0 km segment of the three-way route; route midpoint is within ~200 m)
notes: Inside Flinders Chase National Park; the NPWS page lists it as Return Road Hike (3 hrs, 9 km).

Needs a park pass entry 'flinders-chase' in parkPasses.ts: NPWS lists site entry $22.40 per person in the page header, but the page's Fees tab lists Adult $13.00 (conflict, see unverified). A Kangaroo Island Tour Pass (adult $58.50) also covers entry.

kangaroo-island-51.name: Harveys Return Hike
kangaroo-island-51.bio: A short, steep hike from Harveys Return campground down the lightkeepers' old route to the bay, with ocean views.
kangaroo-island-51.coordinates_source: Midpoint by length of the Walking SA GPX track for Harveys Return Hike (0.48 km, walkingsa.org.au/walk/find-a-place-to-walk/harveys-return-hike/); trailhead is the carpark at Harveys Return campground (OSM node -35.75127,136.63802)
notes: Draft bio was wrong: this is not a walk toward Cape Borda. Walking SA describes a short hike down to Harveys Return (the bay) on the lightkeepers' original route; the old trackway continues steeply with a rock scramble to the bay. The Return Road Hike is the one that runs to Cape Borda.
Not a duplicate of Return Road Hike (pins ~1.8 km apart), though both start at Harveys Return.
Inside Flinders Chase National Park; same pass note as Return Road Hike.

kangaroo-island-52.name: Snellings Beach
kangaroo-island-52.bio: A beach at the mouth of Middle River, good for swimming, surfing and river or rock fishing.
kangaroo-island-52.ticket_note: Open beach with no single steward.
notes: OSM and holiday-house names spell it Snelling Beach; the tourism board spells it Snellings. Kept the draft name.

kangaroo-island-53.name: King George Beach
kangaroo-island-53.bio: A pebbly cove beach on the north coast, known for its colour at sunset.
kangaroo-island-53.ticket_note: Open beach with no single steward.
kangaroo-island-53.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: OSM natural=beach 'King George Beach' (way 339931928)
notes: Tourism board page exists (experiences/king-george-beach); one counted source, marginal as flagged by Atlas.

kangaroo-island-54.name: Brown Beach
kangaroo-island-54.bio: A sheltered, easily reached beach on Dudley Peninsula for swimming, snorkelling and shell fossicking, beside a camping ground.
kangaroo-island-54.ticket_note: Open beach with no single steward.
kangaroo-island-54.coordinates_source: resolve-pin HIGH: OSM natural=beach 'Brown Beach' (way 1019411602, beside the campground and viewpoint nodes); a second OSM 'Brown Beach' beach 0.8 km SW was not used
notes: Campground has a fee for camping only; not a visit cost.

kangaroo-island-55.name: Bales Beach
kangaroo-island-55.bio: A surf and walking beach beside Seal Bay, within an aquatic reserve that protects the sea lion breeding colony.
kangaroo-island-55.ticket_note: Open beach; not part of the paid Seal Bay Conservation Park visitor area.
notes: Tourism board: about 1 km off Seal Bay road via Bales Bay Road, small car park, no facilities, fishing not permitted (aquatic reserve). Beach is ~3.4 km east of Seal Bay's visitor centre, so no pin clash.

kangaroo-island-56.name: Beyeria Walk
kangaroo-island-56.bio: A short interpretive walk with twenty signs through narrow-leaved mallee in Beyeria Conservation Park.
kangaroo-island-56.ticket_note: No NPWS page for Beyeria Conservation Park loaded (parks.sa.gov.au slug 404); not guessing a link.
kangaroo-island-56.coordinates_source: Midpoint by length of the Walking SA GPX circuit (walkingsa.org.au/walk/find-a-place-to-walk/beyeria-walk/); trailhead carpark off Willsons Road is at -35.7798,137.5911
notes: Length conflict: tourism board says 1.5 km, Walking SA says a 1.1 km circuit (30 min); bio omits the distance.

unverified: Flinders Chase NP entry price: NPWS page header says site entry $22.40 per person but its Fees tab lists Adult $13.00 / Concession $10.50 (likely stale); a 'flinders-chase' pass is needed in parkPasses.ts and the price must be confirmed in a browser (kangaroo-island-50, kangaroo-island-51)
Waterfall Creek Hike: no fee found for Western River WPA, assumed free (kangaroo-island-49)
